subject.title: Prefer weekly windows in switcher progress

question: Should the combined switcher’s existing “Weekly progress” row retain its intentionally primary-first behavior, or should it become a strict seven-day quota metric whenever such a lane exists?
rationale: Current main and published API documentation establish primary-first selection, while the setting label and linked report support a weekly-first interpretation; selecting the permanent user-facing contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt literal weekly behavior
options.body: Approve weekly-first selection, update the documented helper contract, and require fresh menu proof before merging.

options.title: Retain primary-first behavior
options.body: Keep the current documented metric semantics and close or rework this PR rather than silently changing existing switcher values.

recommendation.title: Adopt literal weekly behavior
recommendation.body: Approve weekly-first selection, update the documented helper contract, and require fresh menu proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a user-facing metric-contract decision for current repository behavior.
